track.title: Afshari: Daramad VII with Bastenegar
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: Daramads I, II, V vote E, Daramads III, IV, VI, VII vote B, the Forud votes F#. Vote kept.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B4 and dwells most on F# in Daramad VII with Bastenegar. The line peaks at B4 (509.3 Hz) at 0:01.9. It closes on the tonic (C#4 → Ds4 → C#4 → C#4 → F#3 → B3).
